fields.description: Verdes by Haven is an apartment and duplex collection within Haven in Dubailand. The buildings sit within a landscaped setting shaped around wellness, shared outdoor space and a community stream. One to three bedroom layouts include different arrangements for family space, work and service rooms.

sources.label: Aldar FY2025 results: project completion estimates

reviewCoverage.identity: Own official Verdes page verified, separate from Haven villa community.
reviewCoverage.residences: Official brochure contains one/two/three-bedroom apartments and two-bedroom duplexes.
reviewCoverage.areas: All eight published sample drawings visually checked; average GFA explicitly excludes balcony.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Facilities checked against project-specific brochure page15. Generic web-page dog park, private cinema and meeting-room icons excluded; nearby amenities not treated as included.

reviewCoverage.payment: Portal 10/50/40 differs from broker 20/40/40, although both total 60/40. Difference disclosed.
reviewCoverage.handover: Developer FY2025 table visually confirms 2028; quarter/month conflicts retained in the note and not presented as confirmed.
reviewCoverage.documents: Official brochure includes plans. Current official CDN mirror and asset.aldar version are identical size/content, counted as one source.

overview: The official project presentation focuses on landscaped surroundings and shared facilities. Apartment living here is a distinct offer from the villas and townhouses elsewhere in Haven; compare the actual building, orientation and entrance route rather than transferring details from the wider community.
research.locationNote: Property Finder identifies Verdes within Haven in Dubailand, Dubai. Confirm the selected building’s approach, parking entrance and access to the facilities that matter to your routine.
research.priceNote: Property Finder advertises AED 1.1m and marks the developer project sold out. The figure is a reference, not confirmation of a currently bookable home; resale and larger layouts can be priced differently.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 10% at booking, 50% during construction and 40% at handover. CASADIOR instead publishes 20/40/40. Both allocate 60% before completion, but the immediate deposit differs; confirm the selected offer’s schedule.
research.handoverNote: Aldar’s FY2025 pipeline lists completion in 2028. Property Finder gives May 2028 while CASADIOR states Q3 2028. The reviewed official brochure does not settle the discrepancy. Obtain a current building-specific handover estimate and the contractual completion conditions.
